To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the most effective way to improve the quality of patient care in a hospital is through physician-hospital collaboration based upon transparency, active listening and prompt implementation.

physicians and hospitals can collaborate to achieve better patient care and financial performance if the parties engage in a structured process of dialogue that includes the following: 1) a focus on the patient, 2) transparency of information and processes, 3) active listening, 4) prompt implementation of agreed-upon solutions, 5) a focus on clinical priorities, and 6) a willingness to engage in a learning process that includes both positive deviance and appreciative inquiry.
physician-hospital collaboration based in transparency and active listening can help hospitals and physicians improve clinical and financial performance and achieve a competitive advantage.
